input.conditions: EUR Personal Savings Account (MassInterest). Your interest rate depends on your personal threshold, which is the highest balance you held in your Savings Accounts during the previous half of the year. It's recalculated twice a year on: January 1 (00:00 UTC): based on your highest balance from July 1 to December 31; July 1 (00:00 UTC): based on your highest balance from January 1 to June 30. You get the following interest on: 3.11% (Bonus Interest) on savings above your threshold (every euro you add above your highest balance earns the highest rate); 1.61% (Starting Interest) on your first €10,000 up to your threshold (if your threshold is lower than €10,000, everything above it earns the Bonus Rate); 1.51% (Base Interest) on any savings above €10,000 up to your threshold (if your threshold is €10,000 or less, all your savings up to your threshold earn the higher Starting Interest instead). Example given: €22,000 saved with a €15,000 threshold → €10,000 earns 1.61%, €5,000 earns 1.51%, €7,000 earns 3.11%; if your threshold is €0 because you just started saving, all your savings earn bonus interest of 3.11% until your first threshold calculation. New savers: when you join bunq you don't have a threshold yet, so you get the bonus rate of 3.11% on all your EUR savings up to €100,000; once your first personal threshold is set on either January 1 or July 1, you get the bonus rate on all savings above your threshold. *The Starting Interest, Base Interest, and Bonus Interest are variable and are subject to change.* Rates went up on October 15, 2026 at 09:30 CEST (Bonus Interest now 3.11% up from 3.01%; Starting Interest now 1.61%; Base Interest stays at 1.51%).
